correctness.rationale: The source proves f irreducible in Proposition 3.2. Compute sigma(c)=c and sigma^2-fixed field F_2(t) for odd r. Coefficient comparison in f(a+bx)=(u+vx)f forces a,b in F_2(t), giving the four-dimensional quadratic crossed product. With i=(t+1)/s and j=x, the relation t^2+st+1=0 in characteristic two yields i^2+i=1/s, j^2=s/(s+1), ji=(i+1)j. At s+1, T^2+T+1 is irreducible mod 2: the quadratic extension is unramified inert and norms have even valuation; v(s/(s+1))=-1, so the algebra is division. These identities apply to all odd r>=3 without finite extrapolation.
